name: linga
description: Root toolchain for the scraper: Engine build (rebuild) and the wasm box (rebuild:wasm)

scripts.rebuild: node scripts/check-node.mjs && if [ ! -d Engine/MonoSyllabism/mapbuilder/node_modules/bytenode ] || [ ! -d Engine/MonoSyllabism/mapbuilder/node_modules/javascript-obfuscator ]; then npm install --prefix Engine/MonoSyllabism/mapbuilder --no-package-lock; fi && node Engine/Bridge/restore-master.js && node Engine/MonoSyllabism/mapbuilder/obfuscator.js
